# Tell me what you'd like to work on

If you're interested in individual coaching or arranging a workshop, send me an email with a little information about what you need.

[**YOUR-EMAIL@example.com**](mailto:YOUR-EMAIL@example.com){.email-link}

It can help to mention:

- Whether you're enquiring for yourself or for an organisation.
- What you'd most like to improve or achieve.
- Your preferred format and any relevant timing.
- For a group enquiry, the approximate number of participants and the workshop length you're considering.

I'll reply to discuss possible next steps.

::: {.small-note}
This site uses an email link rather than an online contact form. Replace the placeholder email address throughout the project before publishing.
:::
